data.one_liner: Detect and track objects in images or live camera feeds using Google's ML Kit.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin providing access to Google's ML Kit Object Detection and Tracking APIs. It enables detecting and tracking objects in static images or live camera streams using a base model, local custom TFLite models, or Firebase-hosted models.
use_when: You need to detect and track bounding boxes of objects in camera feeds or static images.
You want to use custom TFLite models for object detection on mobile devices.
avoid_when: You are building for Web or desktop platforms, which are not supported.
You do not want to manage platform-specific native setup for Android and iOS.
strengths: Supports base model, local custom models, and Firebase models.
Handles both single images and live camera streams via DetectionMode.
weaknesses: Mobile-only (Android and iOS); web and other platforms are not supported.
Requires manual platform configuration including specific iOS deployment targets and Xcode build settings.
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS deployment target 15.0+, Xcode 15.3.0+, Swift Package Manager setup with specific linker flags, downloading ML Kit resource bundles, and setting Android minSdkVersion to 21+ with compile/target SDK 36.
